how_scores_work: Each version gets up to 100 points: evidence that people have this problem (30 points), fit with your skills, budget and time (25 points), places to reach these customers (20 points), can be built as a first version (15 points), room next to existing options (10 points). These weights are design choices, not facts (config/scoring.toml).

points.Evidence that people have this problem: 16 of 30: Found 3 real examples of people describing this problem or looking for help with it, on painonsocial.com, proz.com and vulta.one. Full marks need 5. Of these, 1 is a person describing it first-hand or asking for help; 2 are articles or other pages (these count a little less); 3 of 3 are about your market. For example: “Designers report clients who disappear after receiving files, dispute invoices, or drag out payment for months” / “Many designers start projects without formal contracts, leading to unclear deliverables, payment disputes, and no legal protection when things go wrong”.
points.Fit with your skills, budget and time: 21 of 25: You already have what it takes for ux; you'd need help with web development; it needs about 20 hours (you have about 24 a month) and about $80 (your budget is $150).
points.Places to reach these customers: 13 of 20: These customers can be found on warriorforum.com and webflow.com.
points.Can be built as a first version: 15 of 15: It's a small web tool (like a calculator or planner), which the team can build, and it fits in about a month of your time.
points.Room next to existing options: 2 of 10: Found 3 existing options but no complaints about them. Complaints show where you could do better.

problem_claims: Freelancers feel overwhelmed by scattered invoice records across multiple platforms during tax season preparation.
The lack of a single tool to track invoices creates a structural problem for freelancers with multiple clients.
Designers report clients who disappear after receiving files, dispute invoices, or drag out payment for months.
Many designers start projects without formal contracts, leading to unclear deliverables, payment disputes, and no legal protection when things go wrong.
Agencies and freelance teams need a system to manage multiple client payments, team access, and payment infrastructure for their whole business.
